founder.title: A Word from the Founder
founder.p1: I have been a rider for many years. And like many of you, I learned to read my horse long before I truly learned to ride.
founder.p2: I've always had a simple philosophy, one that some coaches don't necessarily share: I never try to make a horse submit. I prefer to repeat, vary, play — start over differently until the right movement becomes obvious to him, not a constraint. Because he didn't ask for anything. He is there, noble, generous, and he trusts us. It is up to us to be worthy of that.
founder.p3: It was with this mindset that I observed, one winter, something I could no longer ignore. Horses raising their heads. Stepping back. Clenching their teeth. Not out of ill will — out of discomfort. An icy bit in the mouth is not a detail. For such a sensitive animal, it is an assault.
founder.p4: I looked for a solution. I couldn't find one. So I created it.
founder.p5: HOTT is my way of giving back to the horse a part of what he gives us. This silent partner who carries our weight, our moods, our difficult days — and who still sets off the next day with the same generosity. He deserves at the very least that we think of him before even putting on his bridle.
founder.p6: WARMBIT was born from this conviction: your horse's comfort is not a luxury. It is the foundation. And if we can make it accessible to all riders, then we will have done something worthwhile.
